title: Qi-Backed Star Throwing Course
summary: A course that lets a student push steady qi into each throw so the star pierces rather than skims.

title: A Treatise on the Curving Flight
summary: Teaches throws that bend around a raised guard by an offset grip and a controlled thread of qi.

title: Intermediate Drill-Book of the Star Pouch
summary: Drills fast reloading from a belt pouch and bursts of several stars thrown while the body keeps moving.

title: The Ten Lessons of Quick Release
summary: Ten graded lessons that shorten the time between drawing a star and loosing it at a moving mark.

title: Second Handbook of Spoke Work
summary: A follow-up to the beginner texts on hooking snagging and cutting with the held spokes of the star.

title: Guide to Throwing While Moving
summary: Shows how to release accurately in mid stride and during a slide or a pivot with qi steadying the arm.

title: A Reader on Pinning Shots
summary: Teaches throws meant to nail cloth sleeves hands and boots to wood so a foe cannot move freely.

title: Practice Notes on Armored Targets
summary: Covers choosing seams visor slits and joint gaps and hardening the point with qi against mail and plate.
